function: Optimizes the probing beam combination for PBM-based hybrid beamforming in cell-free MIMO, using learned PBM augmentation (CVAE-MDN) and a sum-rate predictor inside a genetic-algorithm search (p. 2-3).
system: Cell-free MIMO downlink, 3 APs with 8x8 UPA serve 6 single-antenna users; hybrid beamforming; 28 GHz, 100 MHz; no RIS (p. 2, 4).
method: CVAE with mixture density network (full covariance, Cholesky training) for PBM augmentation; DNN sum-rate regressor, supervised; genetic algorithm search; unsupervised beam-compression DNN from earlier work (p. 2-4).
data_channel: DeepMIMO O1 scenario at 28 GHz, rows R1000-R2051, APs 1, 3, 5; 200 sets of user locations sampled around six regional centers (p. 4).
test_conditions: Fig. 3(a,b): training on all 8 probing beam combinations; Fig. 3(c): training on 4 combinations, testing on the 4 unsampled ones, 100 test samples (p. 4-5).
baselines: CVAE and VAE-and-MDN augmentation modules; for sum rate, SBF exhaustive search over the entire beamspace as a non-learned reference (p. 4-5).
metrics: MMD between augmented and real PBM distributions; CDF of predicted sum-rates; chosen optimal probing combination; sum rate relative to SBF exhaustive search (p. 4-5).
openness: none; uses the public DeepMIMO O1 scenario [19], no code or link released by the authors (p. 4).
q1_support: p. 4: "scenario from the DeepMIMO channel dataset [19]"; DeepMIMO ray tracing counts as a shared channel model.
q2_support: p. 5: "remaining 4 probing beam combinations only have 100 test samples and no training samples"; the model is tested on probing beam configurations unseen in training (OOD generalization, p. 3).
q3_support: p. 4: "the modules based on CVAE and VAE-and-MDN are compared as baseline schemes"; p. 5: "achieves approximately 90% of the sum rate attained by the SBF exhaustive search".
q4_support: p. 5: "the dimensionality of U g increases quadratically with augmented data dimension, leading to higher training overhead"; qualitative only, no FLOPs, parameter count, or runtime is reported.
q5_support: p. 4: "scenario from the DeepMIMO channel dataset [19]"; public channel dataset used for training and testing, although the authors release no code.
notes: Included letter, area 3: learned PBM augmentation (CVAE and mixture density network) and a sum-rate predictor guide a genetic-algorithm search of the probing beams for PBM-based hybrid beamforming. q3 is 1 but the reviewer should confirm: the CVAE baseline is the traditional model of refs [14], [15] (p. 1, abstract) yet it is also the proposed model without its MDN; the non-learned comparison is the sum rate relative to SBF exhaustive search, stated only in text (p. 5). q2 rests on Fig. 3(c). q4 is 0 because only a qualitative remark on training overhead appears.
